answers.core: Yes, because advertising integration is a common requirement for mobile games. A core solution ensures stability, ease of use, and standardization across projects, making Godot more attractive for mobile developers.
answers.workaround: It can be partially worked around with custom scripts and manual .aar integration, but it is not convenient and can lead to errors, especially for beginners.

title: Proposal: Simplify integration of Appodeal SDK in Godot
